comments.text: Is it just me or we are regressing with this benchmark? Besides, I think we are past benchmarks. Ai is now discovering new math and science. That should be the benchmark. Also kinda weird to think about human/machine benchmarks where the scale would have a mixture of humans above previous human records and in turn some AIs  below humans on some benchmarks. Pretty soon we’ll be comparing ourselves to AI like report card day 😂 Of course, once we fully merge (example neuralink with internet access paired with hud in glasses or preferably in contacts!) We will be smarter than plain AI again probably so at that point it will start getting real interesting.
